raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #55250. DFlash2 drafts inherit the target dtype. Casting the
BF16-trained draft to FP16 can overflow its grouped-convolution residual
stream to `inf`/`NaN`; candidate selection then produces invalid drafts and
the target accepts none of them.

This reproduces on CUDA: `incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2` with
`Qwen3.8-27B-FP8` had 0 accepted tokens from 1,100+ FP16 drafts, while the
same setup in BF16 reached 37-41% draft acceptance.

## Fix

Fail fast for `DFlash2DraftModel` with `--dtype float16` and instruct users
to use `--dtype bfloat16`, rather than silently running ineffective
speculative decoding.

files.patch:
@@ -977,6 +977,24 @@ def config(method, architectures):
     )
 
 
+def test_dflash2_draft_rejects_float16():
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(dtype=torch.float16),
+        speculative_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            method="dflash",
+            draft_model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                architectures=["DFlash2DraftModel"],
+            ),
+        ),
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="DFlash2 speculative drafts.*float16"):
+        VllmConfig._verify_dflash2_dtype(config)
+
+    config.model_config.dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    VllmConfig._verify_dflash2_dtype(config)
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
     ("use_v2_model_runner", "expected_capture_sizes"),
     [

@@ -757,6 +757,17 @@ def _is_dflash_candidate_draft(self) -> bool:
             }.intersection(draft_config.architectures or [])
         )
 
+    def _verify_dflash2_dtype(self) -> None:
+        if (
+            VllmConfig._is_dflash2_draft(self)
+            and self.model_config is not None
+            and self.model_config.dtype == torch.float16
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "DFlash2 speculative drafts do not support float16 because their "
+                "residual stream can overflow. Use --dtype bfloat16 instead."
+            )
+
     def _dflash_needs_multi_kv_group(self) -> bool:
         """Whether a DFlash draft mixes sliding-window and full attention."""
         spec = self.speculative_config
@@ -1511,6 +1522,7 @@ def __post_init__(self):
             logger.info_once("Performance mode set to '%s'.", self.performance_mode)
 
         self.try_verify_and_update_config()
+        self._verify_dflash2_dtype()
         self._reject_mismatched_float_kv_cache()
         self._resolve_and_verify_engram_config()
